Rushing through Pickering Junction (in Pickering, Ontario), VIA Rail Canada train 52/62 heads east.  This combined Corridor train, comprised of F40PH-3 6439 and five LRC cars combined with F40PH-3 four more LRC cars, is heading from Toronto to Kingston, at which point the two trains will be separated with 52 continuing on to Ottawa and train 62 travels to Montréal.  Pickering Junction is where Canadian National's York Sub splits from CN's Kingston Sub.  (August 25, 2019)
